events.title: Annual Sukkur IBA Alumni Homecoming & Executive Reunion 2026
events.description: Join 600+ Sukkur IBA graduates, faculty, and regional chapter leads at the Main Campus Auditorium in Sukkur for keynote sessions, VC Excellence Awards, and the Grand Alumni Dinner.
events.shortDescription: Flagship campus reunion with keynote panels, networking lounges, and gala dinner.
events.location: Main Auditorium, Sukkur IBA University, Airport Road, Sukkur

events.title: Sukkur IBA Career & Graduate Placement Conclave
events.description: Connect directly with 35+ hiring partner organizations including Systems Limited, Careem, HBL, 10Pearls, and alumni-founded startups. Includes live resume clinics and on-spot interviews.
events.shortDescription: 35+ hiring employers, alumni referral desks, and live technical interview booths.
events.location: STBIC & Gymnasium Hall, Sukkur IBA Main Campus

events.title: Global Scholars Panel: DAAD, Fulbright & Erasmus Mundus Prep
events.description: Live interactive workshop led by Sukkur IBA alumni pursuing MS and PhD research across Germany, the US, and the UK. Covers statement of purpose reviews and supervisor outreach.
events.shortDescription: Virtual scholarship masterclass with Sukkur IBA alumni scholars in Europe & USA.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Cloud & FinTech)
jobs.description: Join our core digital banking engineering group in Karachi or remote. You will architect resilient TypeScript/Node.js and React platforms serving millions of transactions daily.
jobs.requirements: 3+ years with React, Node.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. Direct alumni referral fast-track available for Sukkur IBA graduates.
jobs.benefits: Competitive PKR/USD-indexed compensation, family medical insurance, annual stock bonus, flexible hybrid schedule.

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer — Graduate Trainee (Class of 2026)
jobs.description: Dedicated campus placement track for final-year Sukkur IBA BSCS, BSSE, and BSEE scholars. Rotate across full-stack web, cloud DevOps, and applied AI squads.
jobs.requirements: Final-year BSCS/BSSE student or recent graduate (CGPA 3.0+). Strong fundamentals in data structures, TypeScript/Python, and SQL.
jobs.benefits: Market-leading graduate package, MacBook Pro workstation, mentored onboarding by SIBA alumni leads.

jobs.title: Applied AI & Computer Vision Research Intern
jobs.description: 6-month paid research internship working on multimodal industrial inspection and edge inference pipelines.
jobs.requirements: Strong PyTorch experience, published or ongoing thesis project in CV/NLP, enrolled in BS (final year) or MS Computer Science.
jobs.benefits: Monthly EUR stipend, visa sponsorship support, direct mentorship from Dr. Sarah Khan.

mentorshipRequests.message: Assalam-o-Alaikum Dr. Sarah! I am a final-year BSCS student at Sukkur IBA working on my FYP in Urdu NLP and preparing my DAAD MS application for Munich. I would be honored to receive your guidance.
Hello Ahmed Bhai, I would love your feedback on my distributed systems portfolio project before the upcoming Sukkur IBA Career Fair.

messages.content: Assalam-o-Alaikum Zainab! I reviewed your DAAD statement of purpose draft. Your FYP section on Sindhi/Urdu NLP at Sukkur IBA ORIC is very strong.
Walaikum Assalam Dr. Sarah! Thank you so much for the detailed feedback. I have updated the research methodology section and attached my revised CV.
Hi Zainab! Happy to refer your profile to our Campus Hiring team at Systems Limited before the Career Conclave.
